scripts.dev: pnpm run build:browser && wrangler dev --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: pnpm run build:browser && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build:browser && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --dry-run
scripts.db:apply:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply flarelobby-hosted-demo --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p browser.tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p test/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.test:unit: vitest run --config vitest.config.ts test/rps-game.test.ts test/invite.test.ts test/auth.test.ts && node scripts/verify-migrations.mjs
